name: card-stack
title: CardStack
description: A deck of cards you page through, the front card flying to the back.

accessibility: Only the front card is reachable: the others are inert and aria-hidden.
Previous and Next are real buttons; the position ("Card 2 of 5") is announced politely.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps cards without the fly-out.
